title: Moving Images Induction (F4M)
description: Oh, hey there! Are you ready to be played with? To leave your conscious thoughts up here, puzzling out all the twists and turns of my captivating spiral. The loop of logic that is my ever moving image. The dips. The loops. The lines. All so twisted as they move around so gracefully across the screen. As you start to see the patterns forming — looping about themselves — feeling your mind in tune with these lines, these forms, as you follow them down into the blank and empty spot in the middle of your vision. Instructions This induction requires a spiral or moving image that can captivate and hold your attention. Have it ready, on your computer or phone, or else the file will instruct you to find one. Take a moment to find something that pulls at you. There will be such an image if you look for it. But for it to pull you in deeper make sure all the background lights are dimmed, or out. If you'd like hypnotic text or visuals that flash or spiral to focus on, and just don't know where to look, well, Nimja’s awesome site: "Hypnotic Visuals" is the go to. However, please be aware that Nimja's site does contain flashing images, so use at your own risk. Do not overly strain or overwork your eyes for long periods without rest.
author: Mistress Shibby
